bar_accidental_not_carried.impact: An accidental earlier in the bar still holds on the page, but the file plays the note without it.
bar_accidental_not_carried.title: In-bar accidentals that are not carried

bar_integrity.impact: Bars whose content does not fit the time signature (the app's own validation rule).
bar_integrity.title: Overfull, underfull or empty bars

bar_numbering.impact: The app finds bars by number: a repeated number lays bars over each other, a skipped or reordered one shows wrong bar numbers.
bar_numbering.title: Bar numbers that do not count up by one

grace_notes_dropped.impact: parseMusicXML skips <grace> notes: they are neither shown nor played. A known limitation, not a data error.
grace_notes_dropped.title: Grace notes the app skips

incomplete_bars.impact: A staff's notes and rests stop before the bar ends, or a bar is short (not a pickup, its complement, or half of a bar split at a repeat sign, an ending or a double/final bar line): the app draws the bar short. Stricter than bar_integrity, the app's own check.
incomplete_bars.title: Bars a staff does not fill

key_signature_playback.impact: The page shows the key signature (e.g. F# in G major) but the note has no <alter> and no printed accidental, so the app plays another note (F natural) than the page shows. Cause in the hymns: catalog/hymns/abc-to-musicxml.js writes <alter> only for explicit ABC accidentals; in the other files a natural sign is missing.
key_signature_playback.title: Notes played against the printed key signature (hymn converter)

note_shape_mismatch.impact: The app draws a note from <type> and <dot> and plays its <duration>; where they disagree the page shows another rhythm than the app plays (e.g. an undotted whole note that lasts six beats).
note_shape_mismatch.title: Printed note shapes that say another length

octave_shift_playback.impact: MusicXML keeps the sounding pitch in <pitch> and marks an 8va with octave-shift type="down"; the app treats <pitch> as written and subtracts an octave, so these notes very likely play an octave low (melodic steps at the 8va boundaries: median 3 semitones as written, 10 the app's way). Correctness fixture C10/C11 records the deviation; confirm once by ear in the app.
octave_shift_playback.title: 8va/8vb passages read the app's way

tempo_marks_disagree.impact: The app's score tempo (practice tempo, metronome, tempo %) is the <sound tempo>; its player follows the printed mark written at the same place (PianoScore.tempoMap). The two disagree.
tempo_marks_disagree.title: Files whose <sound tempo> and printed tempo disagree

tie_without_stop.impact: The tied note is struck again instead of held (the app joins a tie only at a matching tie-stop). Cause: abc-to-musicxml.js writes <tie type="start"> and never the stop.
tie_without_stop.title: Tie starts that never stop

wrong_printed_accidental.impact: The printed accidental and the played pitch disagree.
wrong_printed_accidental.title: Printed accidentals naming another pitch

known_failures.scope: committed scores under catalog/ and samples/
